notes.title: Apotheon 1.2 Multiplayer update
notes.content:
Online multiplayer is now out of beta! We've added 4 new maps to it also, and fixed a number of online issues.

Note: Mac/Linux update will go live tonight/tomorrow

We will be releasing a free standalone version called 'Apotheon Arena' soon - so let us know any possible issues you have our forums.

So join a multiplayer game! Or start one and try out the bots

New maps:
- Ares
- Dionysus
- Garden
- Zeus

Changes:
- gamepad support for server selecting
- better bots
- fixed weird characters in Steam username crashing games
- fixed items only spawning on client when host was near

Thanks!
- Lee and Jesse

notes.title: Apotheon 1.1 - Online Multiplayer Beta!
notes.content:
We've added online multiplayer! Right now currently in beta - with five maps, and three game modes (deathmatch, team deathmatch, elimination). There are also bots you can add to fight against.

While developing Apotheon's combat system we wanted to fight each other to really make sure it had a lot of depth - since we didn't live in the same city we added online support early on. The online game modes were one of our favorite parts of the game throughout development - but we decided to not release it with the main game because we didn't want to distract from the large single player adventure.

We've are now planning to release the online modes as a free standalone game - Apotheon Arena, on Steam in the coming months (though this plan depends on how well the beta goes). We want to release it for free so we can have the largest user base possible - and help promote the main single player game. When we release it and with how much content will depend on how this beta goes.

Let us know any feedback in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/208750/discussions/4/]Multiplayer forum[/url]

If servers are empty at times, check it out by starting a bot match! We do not have dedicated servers at this time, but it’s very easy to host your own game.

With this update comes some single player fixes also:
- Fixed bug with players bypassing Hera in Village act 2
- Map overlay turned off if Sea Compass is used
- Fixed bug with player bypassing Thetis in Sea
- Lockbox positions are now reset on reload if not used, incase players knocks them away so they cant get them
- Linux Dualshock lightbar support

Thanks!
- Lee and Jesse

notes.title: Apotheon now available on Mac and Linux!
notes.content:
Thanks to Ethan Lee and his FNA tools, Apotheon is now available for Mac and Linux!

Please post any issues with Mac and Linux in it's forum here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/208750/discussions/3/

On another note - thanks to everyone who enjoyed the game, after four years of development we are extremely happy to see a response like this!
- Lee and Jesse



Mac System Requirements:
OS: Lion 10.7.5, Yosemite strongly recommended 
Processor: Dual Core 2.5 GHz 
Memory: 3 GB RAM 
Graphics: OpenGL 3.0+ support (2.1 with ARB extensions acceptable)

Linux Requirements:
OS: glibc 2.15+, 32/64-bit. S3TC is NOT required. 
Processor: Dual Core 2.5 GHz 
Memory: 3 GB RAM 
Graphics: OpenGL 3.0+ support (2.1 with ARB extensions acceptable)

FNA:
https://github.com/flibitijibibo/FNA
